title: [LT-109754] Timeslot classroom-axis DnD keeps only target classroom in Edit Lesson popup
description: Regression for LT-109754. In Riso extUAT Timeslot view > Daily view > Classroom axis, dragging a lesson from one classroom to another must prefill only the target classroom in the Edit Lesson popup and must not create duplicate classroom assignment after saving.
preconditions:
- Environment: Riso extUAT.
- Enable Calendar Drag And Drop = ON.
- Timeslot view is enabled.
- Lesson L1 exists in Timeslot view Daily > Classroom axis.
- L1 is assigned to exactly one original classroom Classroom A.
- Target classroom Classroom B exists in the same date/timeslot and is selectable.
steps_actions:
1. Open Lesson Calendar > Timeslot view > Daily view > Classroom axis.
2. Drag L1 from Classroom A to Classroom B.
3. Inspect the Classrooms field before clicking Save.
4. Click Save without manually changing the Classrooms field.
5. Refresh Calendar and reopen L1 detail.
steps_result:
1. Calendar loads and L1 is displayed under Classroom A.
2. Edit Lesson popup opens.
3. Classrooms field contains only Classroom B; Classroom A is not pre-populated.
4. Save succeeds.
5. L1 is assigned only to Classroom B; no duplicate classroom assignment remains on the lesson.
steps_data:
1. date = L1 date; view = Timeslot Daily; axis = Classroom
2. source classroom = Classroom A; target classroom = Classroom B
3. expected chips = [Classroom B]
4. 
5. expected final classrooms = [Classroom B]

title: [LT-109520] BO Calendar Lesson popup follows new UI layout
description: Regression for LT-109520. BO Calendar Lesson popup must match the new Lesson UI layout from LT-101769, including Cancellation Reason and Recurring Settings sections.
preconditions:
- Logged in to BO as HQ/CM user with Lesson Calendar access.
- New Lesson UI layout feature from LT-101769 is enabled.
- BO Calendar is accessible.
- At least one editable lesson exists for edit-popup validation.
steps_actions:
1. Open BO Calendar.
2. Click Add Lesson or open an editable Lesson from Calendar.
3. Compare the popup structure with LT-101769 Figma layout.
4. Inspect the Cancellation Reason section where applicable.
5. Inspect Recurring Settings for a recurring lesson/create recurring flow.
6. Save/cancel the popup.
steps_result:
1. Calendar loads successfully.
2. Lesson popup opens using the new UI layout.
3. Fields are arranged according to the new layout; spacing/section grouping does not fall back to the old layout.
4. Cancellation Reason section is present/placed according to the new layout when the lesson status/action requires it.
5. Recurring Settings section is present/placed according to the new layout.
6. Existing add/edit flow still works and no layout-only change blocks the action.
steps_data:
1. surface = BO Calendar
2. action = add/edit
3. Figma node = 12148-60157
4. section = Cancellation Reason
5. section = Recurring Settings
6. regression = existing flow
